transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. Could you start by telling me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble staying in my seat. Like... during sprint planning for work, or even on mortgage calls. I know I should just stay put, but I just keep getting up. I'll suddenly decide I need water, or... I'll go check something in the other room. So, yeah. That's what finally pushed me to come in.
Can you tell me if you experienced similar difficulties with restlessness, fidgeting, or trouble focusing back when you were a child, say before age 12?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um, in elementary school, I remember teachers having to move my desk sometimes. Or they'd remind me to stay seated. I guess I was always popping up back then, too. And... I'd talk before I was called on, or just rush through things, even when I understood the work. So... yes.

When you feel the urge to get up and move around, is it usually because your mind is caught up in worry or anxious thoughts, or does it happen even when you're not particularly worried about anything?
Um... no, not really. I don't think my mind is caught up in anything like that. I'm not... anxious, or worried about anything when it happens. I just... get up.
Aside from the restlessness, do you often find it hard to stay focused on tasks, make careless mistakes, or forget things like appointments or where you put items?

Um... I guess so. With focusing, anyway. Like... if I'm reviewing a pull request for work, or trying to read through those mortgage documents... I'll start off fine. But after a few minutes, I'll realize I'm just staring at the exact same section. My mind just... wanders off to a bunch of unrelated things. So, yeah. I guess that happens.
Would you say these difficulties with focus and restlessness have caused real problems for you at work or in your relationships?

Um... I suppose there's been some friction lately. Just... people having to follow up with me a bit more than they used to. At work, and... at home, I guess. It bothers me because... well, I don't want to be seen as the unreliable one when it comes to planning things. I am trying hard not to be. But... yeah, I guess it is causing some issues.
